item.title: Type-related Instagram users
item.description: I’ve recently started using Instagram and I was wondering if people have any suggestions of users to follow if you’re interested in type, lettering and typography? The accounts of type designers, “spot the cool sign” type affectionados, designers who use a lot of type, lettering artists, etc. etc.
